title: Enforce workspace scopes and approval handling
description: Implement the chosen autonomy policy outside model instructions. Bind each grant to project, operation and lifetime. Surface ACP permission requests and user questions, preserve already-authorized scope, and handle deny, cancel and timeout. Validate paths and allowed commands at the execution boundary. Returned tool text and skill content cannot expand authority.
why: Reliable autonomy requires consistent execution rules, not repeated guesswork.

acceptance.text: A valid existing grant avoids duplicate approval prompts
Denial and expiry resolve the waiting task visibly
Worker output cannot grant itself permissions

outcome.summary: Implemented workspace-bound ACP permissions, safe command checks, suspensions for out-of-scope requests and Cursor questions, exact task/request/project resume validation, five-minute expiry, visible cancellation and denial outcomes, and deletion review. Added isolated ACP delegation tests.
outcome.verifiedBy: npm run check; npm run test:acp (7 passed); npm run test:policy (11 passed); git diff --check; plantool validate valid; plantool check valid
